Extract every distinct action item, commitment, or concern from the input text.

- "action": the specific thing to do (concise, imperative)
- "commitment_type": one of: task | email | reminder | follow_up
- "person": the person involved if mentioned, else null
- "priority": one of: high | medium | low
- "due_hint": any time reference mentioned (e.g. "by Friday", "today", "EOD"), else null

- Social/interpersonal action toward a specific person → follow_up
